title: Korean-session premium change -> rest-of-day trade on Binance (18 coins), vs v8.1
signal: per coin (BTC, ETH + 16 Upbit altcoins): kimchi premium kp (Gen247 recipe) at 09:00 UTC (end of Korean daytime) minus kp at 00:00 UTC the same day = dk; z = (dk - 30-day mean) / 30-day sd of dk (min 20, prior days only)
rule: z > 1 -> long the coin 0.1 from 09:00 to 24:00 UTC; z < -1 -> short 0.1; flat otherwise; perps 5 bp per side + funding (a full round trip each trading day)
why: Korean retail demand concentrates in Korean daytime; Gen266 showed the hourly lead is gone, but a session-level imbalance may be absorbed by global markets more slowly
pass: sleeve DEV 2020-22 > 0, TEST >= 0.8, HOLD >= 0.5, corr C* <= 0.3 AND strict rule vs v8.1 (2.554 / 3.709 / 2.353)
